proposed.sourceName: JAKIM e-SMAF — Muzakarah Khas Jawatankuasa Fatwa MKI, 'Alkohol Dalam Makanan, Minuman, Pewangi Dan Ubat-Ubatan' (14–16 July 2011)
proposed.paraphrase: The Special Muzakarah of Malaysia's National Fatwa Committee, published in JAKIM's e-SMAF fatwa database, rules alcohol from khamr production haram and najis, permits soft drinks below 1% v/v only when not produced as khamr, and caps non-khamr alcohol used to stabilise flavourings/colourings at 0.5% in the final product — an alcohol/additive regime at least as strict as the hanafi-strict position. (Seafood caveat: Malaysia follows the Shafi'i view permitting all seafood, an axis the app's hanafi-strict flags but does not currently enforce in the grade matrix.)
